reading.body:
Expedient Pittsburgh South publishes 6 MW of IT capacity across 26,000 square feet of technical space, split across two Pittsburgh addresses. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 6 MW of IT load is roughly 150 racks. At 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation density, it is roughly 600 racks. The operator does not publish a per-rack power figure, so neither translation is the operator's claim.

The three certifications define what this campus is qualified to host. PCI DSS qualifies it for workloads that handle payment card data. HIPAA and HITRUST together qualify it for regulated healthcare data and the auditing frameworks that accompany it. Those certifications point toward enterprise compliance workloads rather than large-scale AI training, which typically does not require them, though they do not preclude inference or data-preparation workloads that sit inside a regulated environment.

Within Pennsylvania, this site is the largest campus by published IT capacity on record for this site. Pennsylvania has 14 mapped facilities, but only 2 publish a megawatt figure, and those two together total 11 MW. Expedient Pittsburgh South accounts for 6 of those 11 MW, meaning it represents the majority of the published capacity this site can quantify in the state. That ranking reflects the limits of published data as much as it reflects the campus itself: most Pennsylvania facilities in this dataset publish no capacity figure at all.
